column4: HPSF allocation sizes could overflow silently
column12: 145ca469d9 (TestOverflowHardening) rejects a UnicodeString whose length 0x40000001 doubles past Int32.MaxValue instead of letting the product wrap; parse a SummaryInformation section (format id F29F85E0-4FF9-1068-AB91-08002B27B3D9, code page 1252) whose property 2 is a VT_LPWSTR with the character count 0x40000001 and no characters, and property 3 a VT_I4 of 7, and expect Parse to return property 3 equal to 7 and no property 2; until #961 the doubling escaped from OlePropertySet.Parse as OverflowException (PropertySetReader.ReadUnicodeString)

column4: HPSF allocation sizes could overflow silently
column12: the same commit stops the element count of a VT_ARRAY, the product of its dimension sizes, from wrapping; Bodu implements no arrays, so an array value must be dropped like any type it does not read: parse a SummaryInformation section (format id F29F85E0-4FF9-1068-AB91-08002B27B3D9, code page 1252) whose property 2 is a VT_ARRAY | VT_I4 (0x2003) with one dimension of two elements, 10 and 20, and property 3 a VT_I4 of 7, and expect property 3 and no property 2; until #962 Bodu masked the type with 0x0FFF and read the array as a scalar VT_I4 holding the first word of its header, 3 (PropertySetReader.ParseTypedValue)

column4: A dictionary entry length above Int32.MaxValue escaped as an arithmetic error
column12: 941f09ecce (TestOverflowHardening.dictionaryEntryLengthAboveIntMaxIsTreatedAsCorrupt) keeps the length a long until it is checked, so the section takes its corrupted-dictionary path; parse a user-defined section (format id D5CDD505-2E9C-101B-9397-08002B2CF9AE, code page 1252) whose property 0 is a dictionary of one entry, id 5, of length 0xFFFFFFFF, with property 3 a VT_I4 of 7, and expect property 3 and no named properties; until #961 the narrowing escaped from OlePropertySet.Parse as OverflowException (PropertySetReader.ParseDictionary)

column4: Bugzilla 62451: a far-future last-printed date was misread
column12: 5bb9ab0609 (TestHPSFBugs.bug62451) holds a FILETIME as one 64-bit value, which its high and low halves misread for the time 920355314183864 milliseconds after 1970, the FILETIME 9319997877838640000 whose top bit is set; parse a SummaryInformation section (format id F29F85E0-4FF9-1068-AB91-08002B27B3D9, code page 1252) whose property 11 is that VT_FILETIME, write the set with ToArray, parse the result, and expect property 11 to hold the same 64 bits (Bodu keeps them today, checked with a scratch probe; LastPrinted is null for it, the time lying past DateTimeOffset.MaxValue)

column4: Bugzilla 61809: SectionIDMap get and put looped forever
column12: API Bodu does not offer: POI's SectionIDMap, its table of well-known property names by format id, whose hand-written map cbfb179254 replaces

column4: Bugzilla 61295: a corrupt vector length ran out of memory
column12: 1aa1e25f71 grows the element list as it reads instead of allocating the declared count; parse a SummaryInformation section (format id F29F85E0-4FF9-1068-AB91-08002B27B3D9, code page 1252) whose property 2 is a VT_VECTOR | VT_I4 declaring 0x7FFFFFF0 elements followed by two, and property 3 a VT_I4 of 7, and expect property 3 and no property 2, without OutOfMemoryException (Bodu does so today, checked with a scratch probe)

column4: Bugzilla 52117: an undefined last-printed date was returned as a date
column12: 98b10cf684 (TestBasic.bug52117LastPrinted, TestBug52117.doc) reports a zero FILETIME as an undefined date and reads the edit time 1800000000 as a duration; parse a SummaryInformation section (format id F29F85E0-4FF9-1068-AB91-08002B27B3D9, code page 1252) whose property 11 is the VT_FILETIME 0 and property 10 the VT_FILETIME 1800000000, and expect LastPrinted null and TotalEditTime three minutes (Bodu does so today, checked with a scratch probe)

column4: Bugzilla 52372: a corrupt section ran out of memory
column12: 24f2dcf6cb rewrites Section to read no more than its sizes allow (TestBug52372.doc); the existing test parses a section that declares more properties than its bytes hold and expects CompoundFileFormatException with the category InvalidPropertySet, without allocating the declared count

column4: Bugzilla 61062: various HPSF fixes
column12: no commit names the bug, and its report (https://bz.apache.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=61062) is open only to logged-in users; the HPSF commits of 3.17-beta1 (06eb866034, c22e972b3d, 57460325b4, 2da5cb1276) rework the reader without a regression test that names a defect

column4: Bugzilla 56194: thumbnail clipboard format tags were read unsigned
column12: API Bodu does not offer: POI's Thumbnail, which decodes the clipboard format of PIDSI_THUMBNAIL ([MS-OSHARED] 2.3.3.1.2); Bodu returns a VT_CF value as its bytes

column4: Bugzilla 56138: a zero-length code page string failed
column12: 220b263830 (TestHPSFBugs.test56138, TestZeroLengthCodePage.mpp) reads a VT_LPSTR of size 0 as an empty string, where it indexed the byte before its start; parse a SummaryInformation section (format id F29F85E0-4FF9-1068-AB91-08002B27B3D9, code page 1252) whose property 2 is a VT_LPSTR of size 0 and property 3 a VT_I4 of 7, and expect an empty string and 7 (Bodu does so today, checked with a scratch probe)

column4: Bugzilla 55901: PropertySetFactory threw an exception type from Java RMI
column12: language: an exception type from java.rmi

column4: Bugzilla 55191: a string property stored as another type threw a cast error
column12: b3608a4cfa makes the string getters render a byte array or other value as text instead of casting it; Bodu's typed views read through OlePropertyValue.AsString, which returns null when the value is not a string (OlePropertyValue.cs:126-128): parse a SummaryInformation section (format id F29F85E0-4FF9-1068-AB91-08002B27B3D9, code page 1252) whose property 2 is a VT_BLOB of the bytes 41 42 43 44, and expect Title null and no exception

column4: Bugzilla 54233: Unicode strings off a 4-byte boundary failed
column12: 80677e58b3 (TestHPSFBugs.test54233, TestNon4ByteBoundary.doc) rereads a VT_LPWSTR whose length is implausible from the next 4-byte boundary when it begins 2 bytes past one, since some writers aligned the string rather than the property; parse a SummaryInformation section (format id F29F85E0-4FF9-1068-AB91-08002B27B3D9, code page 1252) whose property 2 begins at a section offset of 2 mod 4 with its type word, two zero bytes, the length 3 and the characters a, b and null, and property 3 a VT_I4 of 7, and expect ab and 7; until #963 Bodu dropped property 2

column4: Bugzilla 52385: vectors of variants were read with padding between elements
column12: b10ba1a85b (TestVariantSupport.test52337) reads the elements of a VT_VECTOR | VT_VARIANT without padding them, as Office writes the heading pairs of its document summary information, and [MS-OSHARED] 2.3.3.1.12 to 2.3.3.1.15 define those strings as unaligned: parse a DocumentSummaryInformation section (format id D5CDD502-2E9C-101B-9397-08002B2CF9AE, code page 1252) whose property 12 is a VT_VECTOR | VT_VARIANT of a VT_LPSTR of size 6, Title and a null, unpadded, then a VT_I4 of 1, and expect the elements Title and 1; until #956 Bodu padded the string to 8 bytes and read the second element as null

column4: Bugzilla 45583: a ClipboardData value past the declared section size failed
column12: 4d835fbda7 (TestHPSFPropertiesExtractor.test42726, 42726.xls) reads a VT_CF value from its own size field instead of failing when it lies past the size its section declares; parse a SummaryInformation section (format id F29F85E0-4FF9-1068-AB91-08002B27B3D9, code page 1252) that declares a size covering only its header, its two pairs and its code page, and whose property 17, placed after that, is a VT_CF of 8 bytes, and expect those 8 bytes (Bodu reads them today, checked with a scratch probe)

column4: Bugzilla 46472: extracting properties failed without custom properties
column12: f1b20beca1 makes HPSFPropertiesExtractor handle a document summary that has no custom properties; the existing test reads a DocumentSummaryInformation with no user-defined section and expects CustomProperties to be empty

column4: Bugzilla 46043: HWPF wrote its HPSF properties incorrectly
column12: API Bodu does not offer: 13d429e01b changes how HWPFDocument writes the summary streams of a .doc it saves; Bodu.IO.Compound has no document model that rewrites them

column4: Bugzilla 44375: a broken dictionary failed the document summary
column12: 4a43c3b1ea catches the error a bogus dictionary entry raises and keeps the entries before it; parse a user-defined section (format id D5CDD505-2E9C-101B-9397-08002B2CF9AE, code page 1252) whose dictionary names property 2 One and property 3 Two and then holds a third entry whose length runs past the stream, with properties 2 and 3 the VT_I4 values 11 and 22, and expect the named properties One = 11 and Two = 22 (Bodu does so today, checked with a scratch probe)

column4: Bugzilla 44491: POIDocument's property handling broke HPSF used with HSSF
column12: API Bodu does not offer: POIDocument, POI's base class for documents, which reads their property sets lazily

column4: Bugzilla 22963: getEditTime returned a date rather than a duration
column12: d99a03d6d9 makes SummaryInformation.getEditTime return the FILETIME count, where it returned a Date, since PIDSI_EDITTIME holds a duration; the existing test reads that property as a TimeSpan
